description_sq:
Toka eshte e rrethuar me mur dekorativ guri.
Me pamje panoramike, rruge te shtruar, uje dhe energji elektrike. E mbjelle me peme frutore dhe e pershtatshme per cdo lloj ndertimi apo biznesi. 11km nga Tirana.
1850 metra ne tota, vetem 100 euro/m² Okazion
description_en: The land is surrounded by a decorative stone wall. With panoramic view, paved road, water and electricity. Planted with fruit trees and suitable for any type of construction or business. 11km from Tirana. 1850 meters in total, only 100 euros/m² Opportunity
